The independent live scheduler read confirms the same task's last-run timestamp and shows a later metadata update before the current enabled=true state. Role-local LATEST still points to config6 at 19:01:19 JST.
findings.exact_scope: The exact multi_agent scheduled task and its config7 canary interval only. This does not establish a platform-wide scheduler failure rate or the actor/stage that disabled the task.
findings.phase1_gate_effect: scheduler persistence remains FAIL/OPEN; re-enable-only repair is not acceptance evidence
